messages:
Ava: Quick async check — we're doing a tiny QBR/Q2 milestone scrub. Can owners confirm shipped vs slipped for the two eng-led milestones: "Model routing policy v1" and "Batching + KV-cache improvements"? Need rollforward plan by EOD Fri.
Leo: Model routing v1 — shipped core routing rules & rule-engine proto, but we had to rollback the canary for region failover (latency regression). So partially shipped (core + tests), canary failed.
Sofia: Batching + KV-cache — most of the batching infra landed, but the 4-bit quant path integration slipped due to an edge-case in attention kernel. Tests caught it. No customer-facing incident.
Marta: From product: routing regression affected 2 enterprise tenants on CAN via dedicated pool; they noticed 95th latency spike. We need an owner to coordinate rollback mitigation + communications.
Ravi: Infra note — the dedicated GPU team is on a capacity update that blocks our ability to spin extra canary nodes until Tues. That was the main blocker for routing failover tests.
Leo: @Ravi thanks. So next steps: 1) revert canary changes to restore baseline (if safe), 2) re-run perf tests with full KV cache disabled for failover path, 3) re-deploy a smaller canary when capacity is available. Who owns 1 & 2?
Sofia: I can own 1 (revert & baseline restore) and 2 (perf re-run) — will open a small PR and smoke tests. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/5678|routing#5678>.
Ava: Great — @Sofia please add a quick checklist in the PR description: steps to revert, how to validate, rollback window. Also add the customer list for comms.
Sofia: Will do. ETA for PR: Tue morning. I can do the rollback window Tue 10–11am PST if infra allows.
Marta: I'll draft a short outbound note for the two affected customers, mark as FYI until we confirm rollback window.
Leo: For batching + quant path: who can pick up the kernel edge-case? It's a tricky mem-shift when seq_len > 2x baseline.
Sofia: I'm already looking but need help from research to confirm approach. @Leo can you loop @Research?
Leo: Yep — pinged @Research in the other thread, but I'll paste a short summary and ask for a 30-min sync tomorrow.
Ravi: Once Sofia has a proposed fix, infra can help run a hardware matrix across A100/MI250. But need a ticket to attach capacity request.
Ava: Action log so everything's clear: 
- Sofia: own routing rollback + perf re-run (PR #5678). ETA Tue AM.
- Leo: coordinate research sync on quant kernel.
- Marta: draft customer comms & update roadmap items.
- Ravi: create infra capacity ticket for canary nodes + HW matrix run.
Sofia: I'll add the action list to the PR and link infra ticket when created.
DeployBot: Deployment canary started: routing-canary-3 -> 5% traffic in prod (triggered by Sofia) :rocket:
Leo: Wait — is that the old canary? We need to stop it until rollback plan is in place.
Sofia: Oh — that was an automated retry from CI. Stopping now.
DeployBot: Canary canceled: routing-canary-3 (5% -> 0%).
Marta: Thanks for the quick stop. Small ask: can we surface a short postmortem template for slipped milestones (1 pager) so PM/Eng align on root cause + rollout plan?
Ava: Yes, I'll drop a lightweight template in #docs after this thread. Keep it to 1–2 paragraphs + actions.
Leo: Who will own the owner-confirm column on the OKR tracker? Need names to mark shipped/slipped.
Sofia: I'll mark routing as partially shipped + note rollback in tracker.
Marta: I'll mark batching as slipped and add product impact details.
Ava: OK — final requested commitments: owners confirm in tracker by EOD Fri and add next-step dates. If anyone can't hit EOD, ping here with updated ETA. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: I'll have infra ticket up by EOD today.
Sofia: PR opened and checklist added — link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/5678|routing#5678>. Aiming merge Tue after perf validation.
Marta: Outbound note drafted, will hold sending until rollback is scheduled.
Leo: Research sync scheduled Wed 9am PT to tackle quant kernel path.
Ava: Thanks all — this is perfect. We'll reconfirm on Fri async thread. If anything blocks earlier, drop a note here or DM owners. :v:
